Define the input schema for a sales event stream. Each event must include: event_id (string), product_id (string), revenue (decimal), event_time (ISO-8601 timestamp), and a processing_time field that the runtime will populate. Specify the semantics contract for the stream, including whether events are append-only or can be updated/retracted.
